Updated for the 2 November 2026 game patch (game build 1283531). After the patch 1.0.1 switched itself off ("host signatures not found; disabled" in greeneye\loader.log): beacons were not saved and the map showed no beacon buttons. On a dedicated server, update the server's copy too.
New: with The Worst Map Mod (1.3.27 or newer), the Return Beacons you reached are lit up on its Hollow Halls dungeon maps; click one to travel there.
